title: BillingTierRequest
description: billing.tier-request@1: the body of PUT /api/v1/tiers/:streamer/:tier on OpenVibe.Billing (billing.tier.manage): the monthly price of one of a creator's subscription tiers (1 to max_tiers), which the creator chooses on the product that sells it (OpenVibe.VIP) and Billing keeps and charges (ADR-012: Billing prices, products never do). price_cents must be within Billing's bounds (min_price_cents to max_price_cents, from GET /api/v1/tiers/:streamer or /api/v1/rates). status archived stops new subscriptions to the tier; running ones renew at the price they were bought at. A tier without a row: tier 1 is sold at the site's default subscription price, any other tier is refused (billing.tier_unknown). GET /api/v1/tiers/:streamer takes no body. The PUT needs an Idempotency-Key header and is refused with 503 billing.frozen while the economy is frozen.

status.description: active (the default) sells the tier; archived sells it no more.
